items.text: Chargers (final report): OUT: S Derwin James (hamstring), G Kayode Awosika (fibula), DB Deane Leonard (concussion), WR Brenen Thompson. QUESTIONABLE: CBs Donte Jackson and Rodney Shelley (hamstrings). LT Rashawn Slater is on IR. Justin Herbert is coming off the Week 7 bye and is not on the report.

Rams (final report): DOUBTFUL: LS Joe Cardona (ankle). QUESTIONABLE: C Coleman Shelton (hip), TE Colby Parkinson (rib), CB Trent McDuffie (groin), WR Jordan Whittington. Myles Garrett, Kobie Turner, Poona Ford and Davante Adams are on IR.
